discover: Open the app, and a live map lights up with every game around you.
Filter by sport: cricket, football, basketball,
and see what's live right now.
join: Tap a match to see when and where, the skill level, and how many spots are left.
One tap, and you're on the roster.
Add it to your calendar, or share it with a friend.
checkin: On match day, check in step by step.
So the organiser knows exactly who's coming.
gameon: Once it's game on, everything lives inside the match.
Chat with everyone, or just your team.
Follow the live scoreboard, ball by ball.
Can't make it? Watch the stream.
host: Want to run your own game?
Tap plus, pick a sport, a time and a ground, and it's live on the map.
Make it weekly, or keep it invite-only.
levelup: with competitive and practice tracked separately.
And a reliability score that proves you turn up.
